The bug was in `search()`: `while ((lo < hi))` exits without ever testing the last remaining candidate. For `search 9 1 3 5 7 9`, `lo`/`hi` converge on index 4 (value 9) but the loop had already terminated, returning `-1`. Changed the condition to `lo <= hi`; the loop still exits correctly for absent values since `hi` drops below `lo`.
